title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
title_zh: RICoT：用于页面流分割的递归交错思维链
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. On FinancePSS-205, RICoT matches or outperforms pairwise and windowed prompting with the same backbone for each of three open-weight LLMs; on a TABME test subset, RICoT with GLM-5 reaches document F1 0.847 and boundary F1 0.915, above published zero-shot results. A 2B-parameter student, trained on a larger teacher's decisions with and without the page-level reasoning, performs comparably in both modes and comes within 0.05 document F1 of the strongest prompted model on FinancePSS-205.
abstract_zh: 页面流分割（Page Stream Segmentation, PSS）旨在将多页文件拆分为其中的独立文档。现有公开的 LLM 方法大多仅依据一页或少量相邻页面判定文档边界，而商业文档拆分 API 通常不公开实现方法。本文将 PSS 重构为遍历整个页面流的序列决策任务，并提出提示框架 RICoT（Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought）：在滑动窗口内逐页推理并确定边界，再处理下一页；在窗口之间传递已读内容的简要记录，从而控制单次调用成本。作者还提出了计划公开发布的 FinancePSS-205，包含 205 个来自真实场景、经去标识化处理的金融页面流。在该基准上，使用相同骨干模型时，RICoT 在三种开放权重 LLM 上均达到或超过成对提示和窗口提示基线。在 TABME 测试子集上，RICoT 搭配 GLM-5 获得 0.847 的文档 F1 和 0.915 的边界 F1，高于已发表的零样本结果。一个 2B 参数学生模型利用更大教师模型的决策进行训练，无论是否加入教师的逐页推理，表现均相近；其在 FinancePSS-205 上的文档 F1 与最强提示模型相差不到 0.05。
key_points_zh: RICoT 将局部边界分类改为贯穿整个页面流的逐页决策，通过跨窗口传递简要记录来保留上下文并控制单次调用成本。
FinancePSS-205 包含 205 个真实、去标识化的金融页面流；在相同骨干模型下，RICoT 在三种开放权重 LLM 上均不逊于成对提示和窗口提示基线。
在 TABME 测试子集上，RICoT 搭配 GLM-5 的文档 F1 为 0.847，边界 F1 为 0.915，均高于已发表的零样本结果。
2B 参数学生模型在加入或不加入教师逐页推理的两种训练设置下表现相近，文档 F1 距 FinancePSS-205 上最强提示模型不到 0.05。
